title: 03 · Vulnerability Assessment — Evidence and Freshness
prompt: Design a NEW trustworthy vulnerability assessment workbench expanding the existing asset vulnerability panel and CVE feed settings. First viewport: nas-01 asset context, explicit assessment state 'Needs identity', feed summary 'Last successful sync 3 days ago · Stale', and actionable amber guidance. A dense asset assessment table or asset rail lets the user inspect pve-01, docker-01, nas-01, grafana across Assessed, Stale, Insufficient identity and Unavailable states. Main panel shows exact vendor/product/version used, match confidence described as evidence not an invented numeric score, and candidate CVE findings with severity, affected range, installed version and applicability. Clicking a finding opens an evidence drawer showing inclusive/exclusive boundaries and uncertainty. 'Correct identity' opens editable identity fields and locally changes the assessment preview. Include 'No matches in this assessment' only alongside evaluated identity and feed timestamp; missing/stale data never produces a green safe verdict. No risk acceptance, triage workflow, exploit claims, offline feed import, or fabricated real CVE vulnerability claims; use clearly synthetic CVE examples. Explicit missing/stale data behavior is 'Mark evaluation unknown; do not treat missing data as zero or as recovery'. Use a clear natural-language rule summary that updates with inputs.
